# 专题 13 词汇辨析、短语及固定搭配（93 题）

说明：本资料由两部分构成，第一部分是 26 年 16 区一模真题，第二部分是 25 年 16 区一二三模真题，真 题质量较高，对于学生刷题效果更佳！

一、26 年 16 区一模真题汇编 57 题（词汇辨析）

- 1．（2026·上海长宁·一模）I ________ take a taxi to work, but this morning I took one because it was snowy. A．seldom B．sometimes C．usually D．always
- 2．（2026·上海闵行·一模）When speaking to the baby girl, her father always looked ________ into her eyes. A．friendly B．likely C．gently D．lonely
- 3．（2026·上海普陀·一模）I don’t drive, so I depend ________ buses and the underground to get around the city. A．of B．on C．for D．at
- 4．（2026·上海长宁·一模）Raise your hand if you know the answers ________ the following questions. A．with B．to C．of D．at
- 5．（2026·上海青浦·一模）The public can get much ________ about the election online or on TV. A．news B．clues C．suggestions D．instructions
- 6．（2026·上海青浦·一模）Sam set off early this morning, ________ he was still late because of the traffic jam. A．but B．so C．and D．or
- 7．（2026·上海青浦·一模）All the players held the rope tightly to the last moment ________ they were tired out. A．since B．unless C．although D．because
- 8．（2026·上海奉贤·一模）The children often visit the old man next door, so he never feels ________. A．lonely B．alone C．friendly D．nicely
- 9．（2026·上海嘉定·一模）My brother and I like playing Ping-Pong. ________ play together on Saturdays. A．He B．They C．We D．I
- 10．（2026·上海黄浦·一模）Follow the instructions strictly, ________ you will damage the engine system. A．so B．or C．and D．but
- 11．（2026·上海黄浦·一模）My father walked around his car to see if there was ________ wrong. A．anything B．nothing C．something D．everything
- 12．（2026·上海黄浦·一模）The Green Great Wall along the desert protects people ________ the sandstorms. A．for B．from C．between D．through


- 13．（2026·上海黄浦·一模）The poor old lady praised John for ________ help and kindness. A．he B．him C．his D．himself
- 14．（2026·上海金山·一模）The firefighters helped all the people leave the building ________. A．save B．safe C．safely D．safety
- 15．（2026·上海金山·一模）The new high-speed railway makes ________ possible to travel between cities quickly. A．it B．this C．that D．one
- 16．（2026·上海金山·一模）—Is this your sister’s smartwatch?

—No, it’s ________. She bought it for my birthday. A．my B．mine C．me D．I

- 17．（2026·上海金山·一模）After helping others, I always feel ________ and useful. A．happy B．happily C．gently D．heavy
- 18．（2026·上海金山·一模）We can find real happiness ________ helping others and sharing kindness around. A．at B．for C．in D．on
- 19．（2026·上海普陀·一模）Don’t let your dog run right after a big meal, ________ it can get a stomachache. A．so B．and C．or D．but
- 20．（2026·上海普陀·一模）The plan to spend the weekend on the beach with family sounds ________. A．perfectly B．sweetly C．lovely D．wonderfully
- 21．（2026·上海闵行·一模）Sam has a big dream of being a dancer. ________ can stop him from standing on the stage.

A．Something B．Anything C．Everything D．Nothing

- 22．（2026·上海宝山·一模）You must conduct the experiment as ________ as possible and never jump to conclusions.

A．carelessly B．careless C．carefully D．careful

- 23．（2026·上海闵行·一模）Mr. Wang is a kind-hearted boss. He seldom gets angry ________ his workers. A．with B．from C．for D．about
- 24．（2026·上海浦东新·一模）It rained heavily outside, ________ the Wangs had to put off the outdoor picnic. A．for B．or C．so D．but
- 25．（2026·上海浦东新·一模）The result depends mainly ________ how well all members work as a team. A．on B．with C．for D．from
- 26．（2026·上海浦东新·一模）________ John has something unknown, he often does some research after class.


- A．Until B．Before C．Although D．When
- 27．（2026·上海宝山·一模）— Henry, where are we going to have our science project discussion?

— I have no idea. Ask our monitor. He ________ know. A．may B．can C．need D．had better

- 28．（2026·上海普陀·一模）Susan tried on several dresses, but ________ of them seemed to satisfy her. A．both B．all C．neither D．none
- 29．（2026·上海闵行·一模）You can find much fine ________ in the modern house in the downtown area. A．painting B．decoration C．furniture D．photograph
- 30．（2026·上海闵行·一模）All of the guests showed up at the party,and the host welcomed ________ warmly. A．they B．them C．their D．theirs
- 31．（2026·上海宝山·一模）The magic show is often regarded as one of ________ experiences in the summer camp.

A．more surprising B．more surprised C．the most surprising D．the most surprised

- 32．（2026·上海闵行·一模）Our country held the grand military parade (大阅兵) ________ September 2025 in Beijing.

A．on B．in C．at D．of

- 33．（2026·上海宝山·一模）Don’t worry. There is nothing wrong ________ your answer to this question. A．of B．with C．for D．beyond
- 34．（2026·上海宝山·一模）There are two coffee shops on this street, but ________ of them stays open late at night. A．all B．both C．none D．neither
- 35．（2026·上海虹口·一模）We can keep Chinese traditions _______ by celebrating festivals and learning traditional skills.

A．alive B．live C．lively D．living

- 36．（2026·上海奉贤·一模）The famous writer will give a speech ________ reading habits to Grade Nine students. A．for B．on C．between D．among
- 37．（2026·上海长宁·一模）The glass is broken. Please be careful with it, ________ it’ll cut your hand. A．and B．but C．so D．or
- 38．（2026·上海奉贤·一模）John is keen on space exploration and always checks the ______ news online. A．late B．later C．latest D．lately


![image 5](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

- 39．（2026·上海奉贤·一模）My grandfather has a good ______ of Chinese history and often tells me interesting stories.

A．knowledge B．information C．advice D．experience

- 40．（2026·上海虹口·一模）It’s a pity that there isn’t much _______ in the house, just a bed and a small table. A．children B．furniture C．sheep D．people
- 41．（2026·上海虹口·一模）The young woman moved _______ the crowd to look for her close friend. A．on B．across C．through D．over
- 42．（2026·上海虹口·一模）Last year, I saw the wild lions and elephants in Africa with _______ own eyes. A．I B．me C．mine D．my
- 43．（2026·上海静安·一模）We need ________ two volunteers to help clean the park this Saturday. A．another B．other C．the other D．others
- 44．（2026·上海静安·一模）________ it was raining heavily, the football match continued as planned. A．Since B．If C．Because D．Although
- 45．（2026·上海静安·一模）Keeping a lovely garden needs a certain amount of daily ________. A．care B．plant C．tool D．space
- 46．（2026·上海静安·一模）Don’t feel ________, Jim. We are all here to support you. A．sadly B．lonely C．angrily D．unluckily
- 47．（2026·上海静安·一模）The movie was quite interesting, ________ the ending was a little disappointing. A．for B．but C．or D．so
- 48．（2026·上海松江·一模）The old man felt ________ after his wife died last year. A．sadly B．lonely C．angrily D．faithfully
- 49．（2026·上海松江·一模）Tourists can enjoy different night views on ________ side of the Huangpu River. A．either B．neither C．both D．all
- 50．（2026·上海松江·一模）We ________ perform a fire safety check every month according to the safety rules. A．can B．must C．may D．ought to
- 51．（2026·上海松江·一模）With limited equipment, the scientists tried ________ best to complete the experiment. A．them B．their C．theirs D．themselves
- 52．（2026·上海松江·一模）Save money every month, ________ you’ll be able to afford a ticket to the concert. A．or B．and C．but D．so
- 53．（2026·上海嘉定·一模）We should think of a better plan, ________ the situation will get worse.


A．and B．but C．or D．so

![image 8](data:image/jpeg;base64,)

- 54．（2026·上海嘉定·一模）In Chinese culture, horses are important symbols, which stand ________ speed and success.

A．of B．on C．in D．for

- 55．（2026·上海徐汇·一模）________ the time being, let’s not make any big decisions until we have more information.

A．At B．For C．From D．On

- 56．（2026·上海徐汇·一模）The most beautiful exhibit in this exhibition was provided ________ an unknown citizen.

A．with B．by C．for D．to

- 57．（2026·上海杨浦·一模）The story is mainly told ________ pictures, so young readers can understand it clearly. A．in B．at C．on D．by

- 58．（2026·上海青浦·一模）Three masked men broke ________ the Louvre Museum and stole some jewelry. A．out B．into C．through D．down

## 三、25 年 16 区一二三模真题汇编 28 题（短语及固定搭配）

- 66．（2025·上海虹口·三模）Since my teammates all fell ill, I had no choice but ______ the report alone. A．finish B．to finish C．finishing D．finished
- 67．（2025·上海虹口·三模）The success of the project depends ______ the effort of every member. A．on B．for C．with D．of
- 68．（2025·上海闵行·三模）We’ll have to work on our own ________ the time being until we find partners. A．at B．for C．with D．from
- 69．（2025·上海杨浦·三模）The politician denied ________ about his educational and working experience. A．lie B．lying C．to lying D．lied
- 70．（2025·上海崇明·二模）Mr. More encouraged his students ________ creatively in order to solve the problem. A．think B．thought C．to think D．thinking
- 71．（2025·上海崇明·二模）The folk art lovers went on ________ paper cuttings, hoping to pass down this traditional skill.

A．do B．did C．to do D．doing

- 72．（2025·上海浦东新·二模）Engineers plan ________ a more powerful battery technology in the next two years. A．develop B．developing C．to develop D．developed
- 73．（2025·上海浦东新·二模）The old couple had pity ________ the homeless cat and gave her food and shelter. A．on B．with C．in D．to
- 74．（2025·上海青浦·二模）Taya is very worried because she hasn’t heard ________ her daughter for two months. A．about B．from C．in D．at
- 75．（2025·上海闵行·二模）We should always be thankful ________ our parents for their love and care for us. A．with B．from C．to D．on
- 76．（2025·上海长宁·二模）Christine refuses ________ her children to the weekend training centre for extra classes.

A．sending B．to send C．sent D．send

- 77．（2025·上海徐汇·二模）________ his surprise, Peter opened the box and found the pet kitten he had always wanted.

A．In B．To C．At D．Of

- 78．（2025·上海徐汇·二模）The farmers in this area had ________ especially hard time this year because of the


flood. A．an B．a C．the D．/
